_readme: Tool-selection eval set. HUMANS write these (not the coding agent) so the eval isn't tuned to the tool descriptions. Target: 40 realistic things a family would say. 'expect.tool' is the first tool Alexa should call; 'expect.args' are key/value pairs that must appear (case-insensitive substring match on strings, exact on others). The three entries below are format examples; replace or keep them.

requests.utterance: Maya is allergic to sesame now
